title: Week of July 20–26
subtitle: Week 6 · Block 2 Week 2 (build) — 4th work set restored on all four mains, warm-ups back, mileage steps to ~18.5. Hold intensity; the deficit is doing the fat-loss work.
goals: Volume restored: mains are back to 4 work sets (calibration week had dropped them to 3), and warm-up sets are back on leg press + hip thrust. This is the exact fix you flagged Mon & Fri.
Mileage ~18.5 mi — a controlled step up from the 17.4 you actually ran. Tuesday is the one hard run (now 6×3 min); everything else strict Z2.

Hold intensity, don't chase: nudge only what you clearly earned (incline bench 150, push press 130). Paused deadlift HOLDS at 225 — the 4th set adds volume, not load — and drops to 205 if the knee talks at all.

Calisthenics stepped forward — and reformatted: Saturday now runs as antagonist supersets (pull-ups+dips, push-ups+leg raises, pike+split squats). Same movements and volume, denser and more fun. Push-ups locked at 20, dips at 3 sets, still chase 18+ on the first max pull-up set.
Under-190 is on track — 195.3 and ahead of pace for 189.9 by Aug 14. Protein ≥180g, eat to the SMART goal. The scale is the arbiter.
review: Week 1 calibration did its job, and you called the miss yourself: two journals flagged that 3 sets on the mains felt like too little volume. You're right — that's a calibration-week artifact (Week 1 of new lifts is deliberately 3 ramping sets to find your numbers), so the 4th work set comes back now that we have them. What you logged: Front Squat 135×5 ('pretty solid'), Incline Bench 145×6 ('significantly stronger'), Push Press 125×6 (you beat the 115 target), Paused DL 225×4 (you noted it needs another week and the knee felt iffy on the last set). So this week: all four mains → 4 work sets; incline bench and push press earn a small top-end nudge (150 / 130); deadlift HOLDS 225 with the 4th set adding only volume, and auto-drops to 205 if the knee complains. Warm-up sets are back on leg press (your ask) and hip thrust. On running — you quietly ran ~17.4 mi, not the 14 the plan asked, and your easy discipline is the best it's been (Sunday's 4-miler came in genuinely easy). So we formalize the progression you're already making: ~18.5 mi, one hard run (Tue, now 6×3 min), the rest strict Z2 — controlled, because the jump from your 12.4-mi deload is already steep and June's burnout is the thing to avoid. Calisthenics gets a real forward step too: push-ups locked at 20 (you moved there on your own), dips to 3 sets, a target to beat on max pull-ups. Big picture on your actual question: the deficit is what's getting you under 190, and it's working — you're ahead of pace. Lifting's job in a cut is to keep the muscle you have (enough volume + heavy loads), not to redline everything at once — that's exactly what re-creates a burnout when you're under-fueled. Next week (7/27) crosses 20 mi and is the last build before the Aug 3 deload.
